design.quote: The Empire HF trial was an investigator-initiated, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial... The primary endpoint of this exploratory substudy was changes in RV free wall strain (RVFWS) across the whole cohort.

population.value: Patients with heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), LVEF ≤40%, NYHA Class I-III symptoms
population.quote: 190 participants with a left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) of 40% or lower, with New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class I-III symptoms

sample_size.quote: a total of 190 patients were enrolled, of whom 160 were included in this substudy

intervention.quote: empagliflozin (at a dose of 10 mg once daily)

follow_up.quote: on top of recommended therapy for 12 weeks

primary_findings.quote: No differences were observed in RVFWS between the groups.
patients in the lowest tertile demonstrated a significant improvement with empagliflozin (treatment effect: -2.9% [95% CI: -5.0 to -0.3]; P = .027)
primary_findings.outcome: RV free wall strain (RVFWS) in lowest baseline tertile

primary_findings.quote: No significant treatment effect was observed in the middle or highest tertiles of RVFWS, nor in the overall or lowest tertiles of TAPSE or RV S'.
